g.text: Found it — the gate was collaterally denying
egress. Filed under #3060; fix adds an explicit
comparator so self-pipe traffic is exempted.
: seccomp couldn't distinguish an MCP server's
async self-pipe wakeup from real network egress without
Should I add a negative witness test proving real egress
is still denied, or is the existing deny-gate coverage
Add the negative witness — we need proof egress is still
denied, not just that self-pipes are allowed.
All green. Both witnesses are in place now:
Type a message — Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a
model sonnet │ agent default │ cost $0.0000 │ ctx 1% │ …
